name: Yagyuu Hayato
source:
Name: Hayato Yagyu
Sex: Male
Age: 42
Birthday: August 3
Profession: Police officer and assassin.
Likes: A special elementary school teacher and her daughter.
Dislikes: Zombies, Haunted houses, Evil crimes.
Hobbies: Camping, Barbecue, Okonomiyaki.
Skills: Assassination.

Hayato Yagyu was Kaname Date's true identity, also known as "Falco" or "#89." He was working as a police officer by day and assassin by night until six years ago.

[From the in-game character description]

Makes a special appearance in [I][url=/v31469]AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES - nirvanA Initiative[/url][/I] as a secret character within a Somnium.
